stem: A crop symptom appears beside one abnormal environmental reading, but a nearby reference sensor disagrees. What is the best next diagnostic action?
choices: Record the first reading as a confirmed cause.
Verify measurement quality and local context before treating the abnormal reading as the cause.
Ignore both sensors and diagnose from leaf appearance alone.
rationale: Conflicting measurements create a data-quality question; verification is required before a consequential correction or causal claim is defensible.
